# projects lists what push-facts targets; --project takes an id or an
# unambiguous name; ambiguous and unknown names exit 2 naming candidates;
# declining exits 0 (the Ruby client crashed here); the FULL payload is
# always shown before anything is sent.

fulcrum projects
grep 'Fulcrum Dogfood' last-stdout.txt
grep 'Acme App' last-stdout.txt
fulcrum projects --json
grep '"client_name": "Headway"' last-stdout.txt

fulcrum push-facts --project 2 --dry-run $WORK/repo
grep '"dependencies"' last-stdout.txt
grep 'rails' last-stdout.txt
grep 'nothing else leaves this machine' last-stdout.txt
grep 'Dry run: nothing pushed' last-stdout.txt

fulcrum -in decline.txt push-facts --project 2 $WORK/repo
grep 'Nothing pushed' last-stdout.txt

fulcrum -in accept.txt push-facts --project 2 $WORK/repo
grep 'the next estimate for project 2 sees these facts' last-stdout.txt

# Case-insensitive unambiguous name match resolves.
fulcrum -in accept.txt push-facts --project dogfood $WORK/repo
grep 'Push to project 2' last-stdout.txt

# Ambiguous name: exit 2, candidates listed, nothing pushed.
fulcrum -code 2 push-facts --project fulcrum $WORK/repo
grep 'ambiguous' last-stderr.txt
grep 'Fulcrum Dogfood' last-stderr.txt
grep 'Fulcrum Website' last-stderr.txt

# Unknown name: exit 2.
fulcrum -code 2 push-facts --project nonesuch $WORK/repo
grep 'no project matches' last-stderr.txt

-- repo/app.rb --
class X
end
-- repo/Gemfile --
gem "rails"
gem 'pg'
-- repo/package.json --
{"dependencies": {"stimulus": "^3"}}
-- decline.txt --
n
-- accept.txt --
y
